purpose: Descriptive, coverage-only diagnostic of the Phase 13G bounded representation and ASFT activation pipeline; not accuracy evaluation or confirmatory theory test.

representation.fit_rule: exact equality across all training demonstrations

budgeted_mode.program_order: first three entries of frozen Phase 13G order
budgeted_mode.runtime_cap: deterministic candidate-trial cap; no Phase 13G wall-clock cap was specified

fullscan_mode.program_order: all frozen Phase 13G programs in frozen order
fullscan_mode.runtime_cap: deterministic candidate-trial cap; no Phase 13G wall-clock cap was specified
fullscan_mode.mode: diagnostic ceiling only; not performance claim

stages.C1: At least one exact-demo-fit candidate found within the specific mode's finite representation, inference, order, and trial budget; bounded operational fit, not proof of semantic representability.
stages.C2: A structured trace record emitted for the task/mode.
stages.C3: The emitted trace's selected program independently replays exactly on all training demonstrations.
stages.C4: A matching invariant candidate is actually emitted by the Phase 13G TraceMiner from successful discovery traces under the frozen support/consistency policy.
stages.C5: Skill candidate available only after C4; not run if the upstream invariant pool is empty.
stages.C6: Transfer eligibility requires an available skill and separate prospective transfer gate; not inferred from task accuracy.
stages.C7: Capability eligibility requires at least two validated reusable skills and transfer evidence; not inferred from ARC score.

accuracy.reason: Coverage benchmark is deliberately test-output blind.
